description: This file defines the class Opencart.System.Library.Template.Twig, which provides a wrapper around the Twig templating engine, including methods for configuration, adding template paths, and rendering templates within the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: Twig
classes.description: A wrapper class to manage the Twig templating engine, including setup, path management, and rendering functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig object, setting the root directory and default loader.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new namespace/path for templates, allowing flexible template organization.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a specified template file with given data, supporting optional in-memory code rendering.
